# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation
# Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1
# with additive one-cluster correction

# Input parameters
p_t <- 0.005           # Treatment rate (events per child-week)
p_c <- 0.010           # Control rate (events per child-week)
E <- 2500              # Exposure per cluster (child-weeks)
cv_k <- 0.25           # Between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05          # Type I error rate (two-sided)
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # Two-sided critical value
z_beta <- qnorm(0.90)  # Power = 0.90, so beta = 0.10
target_power <- 0.90

# Expected number of events per cluster
lambda_t <- p_t * E  # treatment
lambda_c <- p_c * E  # control

cat("Input Parameters:\n")
cat("  Treatment rate (p_t):", p_t, "per child-week\n")
cat("  Control rate (p_c):", p_c, "per child-week\n")
cat("  Exposure per cluster (E):", E, "child-weeks\n")
cat("  Between-cluster CV (cv_k):", cv_k, "\n")
cat("  Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("  Alpha (two-sided):", alpha, "\n")
cat("  z_alpha (two-sided):", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("  z_beta:", z_beta, "\n")
cat("  Expected events/cluster (treatment):", lambda_t, "\n")
cat("  Expected events/cluster (control):", lambda_c, "\n\n")

# The cluster-rate CV approximation for count data (Poisson with between-cluster heterogeneity)
# incorporates a design effect related to the between-cluster CV
# 
# For equal allocation (m = n clusters per arm):
# Sample size formula (before one-cluster correction):
#
# n ≈ (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * [lambda_t*(1 + cv_k^2*(lambda_t-1)) + lambda_c*(1 + cv_k^2*(lambda_c-1))]
#     / [2*(lambda_t - lambda_c)^2]
#
# This formula accounts for the design effect:
# DE_t = 1 + (E-1)*rho_t ≈ 1 + (E-1)*cv_k^2 for Poisson-like rate variation
# But the simplified version for rate differences uses cv_k directly.
#
# For count data with between-cluster variation in rates:
# Variance inflation factor per arm = 1 + cv_k^2*(lambda - 1)

# Calculate variance components
var_inflation_t <- 1 + cv_k^2 * (lambda_t - 1)
var_inflation_c <- 1 + cv_k^2 * (lambda_c - 1)

cat("Design effect calculations:\n")
cat("  Variance inflation factor (treatment):", var_inflation_t, "\n")
cat("  Variance inflation factor (control):", var_inflation_c, "\n\n")

# Sample size formula (before one-cluster correction)
numerator <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * (lambda_t * var_inflation_t + lambda_c * var_inflation_c)
denominator <- 2 * (lambda_t - lambda_c)^2

n_uncorrected <- numerator / denominator

cat("Sample size calculation (before one-cluster correction):\n")
cat("  Numerator (variance term):", numerator, "\n")
cat("  Denominator (effect term):", denominator, "\n")
cat("  Uncorrected n (clusters per arm):", n_uncorrected, "\n\n")

# Apply additive one-cluster correction
n_final <- n_uncorrected + 1

cat("One-cluster correction applied:\n")
cat("  n_corrected = n_uncorrected + 1\n")
cat("  n_corrected =", n_uncorrected, "+ 1 =", n_final, "\n\n")

# Round upward to get integer number of clusters
n_rounded <- ceiling(n_final)

cat("Rounding upward to integer:\n")
cat("  Clusters per arm (rounded):", n_rounded, "\n\n")

# Verification: calculate achieved power at the selected design
# Using the corrected formula:
# z = sqrt(2*n*(lambda_t - lambda_c)^2 / (lambda_t*var_inflation_t + lambda_c*var_inflation_c)) - z_alpha

z_achieved <- sqrt(2 * n_rounded * (lambda_t - lambda_c)^2 / 
                   (lambda_t * var_inflation_t + lambda_c * var_inflation_c)) - z_alpha

power_achieved <- pnorm(z_achieved)

cat("Verification - Achieved power at selected design (n =", n_rounded, "):\n")
cat("  z-statistic:", z_achieved, "\n")
cat("  Achieved power:", power_achieved, "\n\n")

# Also verify at the preceding integer design (n_rounded - 1)
n_preceding <- n_rounded - 1

if (n_preceding > 0) {
  z_preceding <- sqrt(2 * n_preceding * (lambda_t - lambda_c)^2 / 
                      (lambda_t * var_inflation_t + lambda_c * var_inflation_c)) - z_alpha
  power_preceding <- pnorm(z_preceding)
  
  cat("Verification - Power at preceding design (n =", n_preceding, "):\n")
  cat("  z-statistic:", z_preceding, "\n")
  cat("  Achieved power:", power_preceding, "\n\n")
} else {
  cat("No preceding design (n < 1)\n\n")
}

# Summary
cat("="*60, "\n")
cat("FINAL RESULT:\n")
cat("="*60, "\n")
cat("Clusters per arm (rounded upward):", n_rounded, "\n")
cat("Total clusters (both arms):", 2 * n_rounded, "\n")
cat("Achieved power at selected design:", power_achieved, "\n")

# Output in JSON format for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
result <- list(
  sample_size = n_rounded,
  total_clusters = 2 * n_rounded,
  achieved_power = power_achieved,
  uncorrected_n = n_uncorrected,
  n_after_one_cluster_correction = n_final
)

cat("\nDetailed Results:\n")
print(result)

# Emit result in required format
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(
  list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_rounded, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
  list(metric = "total_clusters", value = 2 * n_rounded, unit = "clusters"),
  list(metric = "achieved_power", value = power_achieved, unit = "probability"),
  list(metric = "uncorrected_sample_size", value = n_uncorrected, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
  list(metric = "after_one_cluster_correction", value = n_final, unit = "clusters_per_arm")
)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n")

# Independent verification of the cluster-rate CV sample size calculation
# Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1

# ============================================================================
# STEP 1: Verify input parameters and basic quantities
# ============================================================================

p_t <- 0.005        # Treatment rate (events per child-week)
p_c <- 0.010        # Control rate (events per child-week)
E <- 2500           # Exposure per cluster (child-weeks)
cv_k <- 0.25        # Between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05       # Two-sided significance level
power_target <- 0.90

# Standard normal quantiles
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # Two-sided, so 1 - alpha/2
z_beta <- qnorm(power_target)   # One-sided for power calculation

cat("===== STEP 1: Input Verification =====\n")
cat("Treatment rate (p_t):", p_t, "\n")
cat("Control rate (p_c):", p_c, "\n")
cat("Expected risk difference (p_c - p_t):", p_c - p_t, "\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster (E):", E, "child-weeks\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV:", cv_k, "\n")
cat("Two-sided alpha:", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", power_target, "\n")
cat("z_alpha (two-sided, 1 - alpha/2):", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("z_beta (one-sided power, beta = 0.10):", z_beta, "\n\n")

# Expected event counts per cluster (Poisson mean)
lambda_t <- p_t * E
lambda_c <- p_c * E

cat("Expected events per cluster:\n")
cat("  Treatment (lambda_t = p_t * E):", lambda_t, "\n")
cat("  Control (lambda_c = p_c * E):", lambda_c, "\n")
cat("  Difference (lambda_c - lambda_t):", lambda_c - lambda_t, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: Verify the variance inflation factor formula
# ============================================================================
# The cluster-rate CV formula applies a design effect to account for between-cluster
# heterogeneity in Poisson rates. The variance inflation is:
# VIF = 1 + CV^2 * (lambda - 1)
# This arises from the mixed Poisson model where cluster-specific rates vary
# according to the between-cluster CV.

var_inflation_t <- 1 + cv_k^2 * (lambda_t - 1)
var_inflation_c <- 1 + cv_k^2 * (lambda_c - 1)

cat("===== STEP 2: Variance Inflation Factors =====\n")
cat("VIF (treatment)  = 1 + cv^2 * (lambda_t - 1)\n")
cat("                 = 1 + ", cv_k^2, " * (", lambda_t, " - 1)\n")
cat("                 = 1 + ", cv_k^2, " * ", (lambda_t - 1), "\n")
cat("                 =", var_inflation_t, "\n\n")

cat("VIF (control)    = 1 + cv^2 * (lambda_c - 1)\n")
cat("                 = 1 + ", cv_k^2, " * (", lambda_c, " - 1)\n")
cat("                 = 1 + ", cv_k^2, " * ", (lambda_c - 1), "\n")
cat("                 =", var_inflation_c, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 3: Calculate sample size using the cluster-rate CV approximation

# According to Field Trials Ch 5.6.1, for Poisson counts with between-cluster
# variation in rates, the variance inflation factor is:
# VIF = 1 + CV²(λ - 1)

var_inf_c <- 1 + cv_k^2 * (lambda_c - 1)

# Cluster-rate coefficient-of-variation approximation
# Field Trials of Health Interventions, Chapter 5, Section 6.1
# with additive one-cluster correction

# Input parameters
p_t <- 0.005           # Treatment rate (events per child-week)
p_c <- 0.010           # Control rate (events per child-week)
E <- 2500              # Exposure per cluster (child-weeks)
cv_k <- 0.25           # Between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05          # Type I error rate (two-sided)
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # Two-sided critical value
z_beta <- qnorm(0.90)  # Power = 0.90, so beta = 0.10
target_power <- 0.90

# Expected number of events per cluster
lambda_t <- p_t * E  # treatment
lambda_c <- p_c * E  # control

cat("Input Parameters:\n")
cat("  Treatment rate (p_t):", p_t, "per child-week\n")
cat("  Control rate (p_c):", p_c, "per child-week\n")
cat("  Exposure per cluster (E):", E, "child-weeks\n")
cat("  Between-cluster CV (cv_k):", cv_k, "\n")
cat("  Target power:", target_power, "\n")
cat("  Alpha (two-sided):", alpha, "\n")
cat("  z_alpha (two-sided):", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("  z_beta:", z_beta, "\n")
cat("  Expected events/cluster (treatment):", lambda_t, "\n")
cat("  Expected events/cluster (control):", lambda_c, "\n\n")

# The cluster-rate CV approximation for count data (Poisson with between-cluster heterogeneity)
# incorporates a design effect related to the between-cluster CV
# 
# For equal allocation (m = n clusters per arm):
# Sample size formula (before one-cluster correction):
#
# n ≈ (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * [lambda_t*(1 + cv_k^2*(lambda_t-1)) + lambda_c*(1 + cv_k^2*(lambda_c-1))]
#     / [2*(lambda_t - lambda_c)^2]
#
# This formula accounts for the design effect:
# DE_t = 1 + (E-1)*rho_t ≈ 1 + (E-1)*cv_k^2 for Poisson-like rate variation
# But the simplified version for rate differences uses cv_k directly.
#
# For count data with between-cluster variation in rates:
# Variance inflation factor per arm = 1 + cv_k^2*(lambda - 1)

# Calculate variance components
var_inflation_t <- 1 + cv_k^2 * (lambda_t - 1)
var_inflation_c <- 1 + cv_k^2 * (lambda_c - 1)

cat("Design effect calculations:\n")
cat("  Variance inflation factor (treatment):", var_inflation_t, "\n")
cat("  Variance inflation factor (control):", var_inflation_c, "\n\n")

# Sample size formula (before one-cluster correction)
numerator <- (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * (lambda_t * var_inflation_t + lambda_c * var_inflation_c)
denominator <- 2 * (lambda_t - lambda_c)^2

n_uncorrected <- numerator / denominator

cat("Sample size calculation (before one-cluster correction):\n")
cat("  Numerator (variance term):", numerator, "\n")
cat("  Denominator (effect term):", denominator, "\n")
cat("  Uncorrected n (clusters per arm):", n_uncorrected, "\n\n")

# Apply additive one-cluster correction
n_final <- n_uncorrected + 1

cat("One-cluster correction applied:\n")
cat("  n_corrected = n_uncorrected + 1\n")
cat("  n_corrected =", n_uncorrected, "+ 1 =", n_final, "\n\n")

# Round upward to get integer number of clusters
n_rounded <- ceiling(n_final)

cat("Rounding upward to integer:\n")
cat("  Clusters per arm (rounded):", n_rounded, "\n\n")

# Verification: calculate achieved power at the selected design
# Using the corrected formula:
# z = sqrt(2*n*(lambda_t - lambda_c)^2 / (lambda_t*var_inflation_t + lambda_c*var_inflation_c)) - z_alpha

z_achieved <- sqrt(2 * n_rounded * (lambda_t - lambda_c)^2 / 
                   (lambda_t * var_inflation_t + lambda_c * var_inflation_c)) - z_alpha

power_achieved <- pnorm(z_achieved)

cat("Verification - Achieved power at selected design (n =", n_rounded, "):\n")
cat("  z-statistic:", z_achieved, "\n")
cat("  Achieved power:", power_achieved, "\n\n")

# Also verify at the preceding integer design (n_rounded - 1)
n_preceding <- n_rounded - 1

if (n_preceding > 0) {
  z_preceding <- sqrt(2 * n_preceding * (lambda_t - lambda_c)^2 / 
                      (lambda_t * var_inflation_t + lambda_c * var_inflation_c)) - z_alpha
  power_preceding <- pnorm(z_preceding)
  
  cat("Verification - Power at preceding design (n =", n_preceding, "):\n")
  cat("  z-statistic:", z_preceding, "\n")
  cat("  Achieved power:", power_preceding, "\n\n")
} else {
  cat("No preceding design (n < 1)\n\n")
}

# Summary
cat("="*60, "\n")
cat("FINAL RESULT:\n")
cat("="*60, "\n")
cat("Clusters per arm (rounded upward):", n_rounded, "\n")
cat("Total clusters (both arms):", 2 * n_rounded, "\n")
cat("Achieved power at selected design:", power_achieved, "\n")

# Output in JSON format for POWER_AGENT_RESULT
result <- list(
  sample_size = n_rounded,
  total_clusters = 2 * n_rounded,
  achieved_power = power_achieved,
  uncorrected_n = n_uncorrected,
  n_after_one_cluster_correction = n_final
)

cat("\nDetailed Results:\n")
print(result)

# Emit result in required format
cat("\nPOWER_AGENT_RESULT=")
cat(jsonlite::toJSON(list(results = list(
  list(metric = "sample_size", value = n_rounded, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
  list(metric = "total_clusters", value = 2 * n_rounded, unit = "clusters"),
  list(metric = "achieved_power", value = power_achieved, unit = "probability"),
  list(metric = "uncorrected_sample_size", value = n_uncorrected, unit = "clusters_per_arm"),
  list(metric = "after_one_cluster_correction", value = n_final, unit = "clusters_per_arm")
)), auto_unbox = TRUE, digits = 15), "\n")

# STEP 1: Verify input parameters and basic quantities
# ============================================================================

p_c <- 0.010        # Control rate (events per child-week)
E <- 2500           # Exposure per cluster (child-weeks)
cv_k <- 0.25        # Between-cluster coefficient of variation
alpha <- 0.05       # Two-sided significance level
power_target <- 0.90

# Standard normal quantiles
z_alpha <- qnorm(1 - alpha/2)  # Two-sided, so 1 - alpha/2
z_beta <- qnorm(power_target)   # One-sided for power calculation

cat("===== STEP 1: Input Verification =====\n")
cat("Treatment rate (p_t):", p_t, "\n")
cat("Control rate (p_c):", p_c, "\n")
cat("Expected risk difference (p_c - p_t):", p_c - p_t, "\n")
cat("Exposure per cluster (E):", E, "child-weeks\n")
cat("Between-cluster CV:", cv_k, "\n")
cat("Two-sided alpha:", alpha, "\n")
cat("Target power:", power_target, "\n")
cat("z_alpha (two-sided, 1 - alpha/2):", z_alpha, "\n")
cat("z_beta (one-sided power, beta = 0.10):", z_beta, "\n\n")

# Expected event counts per cluster (Poisson mean)
lambda_t <- p_t * E
lambda_c <- p_c * E

cat("Expected events per cluster:\n")
cat("  Treatment (lambda_t = p_t * E):", lambda_t, "\n")
cat("  Control (lambda_c = p_c * E):", lambda_c, "\n")
cat("  Difference (lambda_c - lambda_t):", lambda_c - lambda_t, "\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 2: Verify the variance inflation factor formula
# ============================================================================
# The cluster-rate CV formula applies a design effect to account for between-cluster
# heterogeneity in Poisson rates. The variance inflation is:
# VIF = 1 + CV^2 * (lambda - 1)
# This arises from the mixed Poisson model where cluster-specific rates vary
# according to the between-cluster CV.

var_inflation_t <- 1 + cv_k^2 * (lambda_t - 1)
var_inflation_c <- 1 + cv_k^2 * (lambda_c - 1)

cat("===== STEP 2: Variance Inflation Factors =====\n")
cat("VIF (treatment)  = 1 + cv^2 * (lambda_t - 1)\n")
cat("                 = 1 + ", cv_k^2, " * (", lambda_t, " - 1)\n")
cat("                 = 1 + ", cv_k^2, " * ", (lambda_t - 1), "\n")
cat("                 =", var_inflation_t, "\n\n")

cat("VIF (control)    = 1 + cv^2 * (lambda_c - 1)\n")
cat("                 = 1 + ", cv_k^2, " * (", lambda_c, " - 1)\n")
cat("                 = 1 + ", cv_k^2, " * ", (lambda_c - 1), "\n")
cat("                 =", var_inflation_c, "\n\n")

# STEP 3: Calculate sample size using the cluster-rate CV approximation
# ============================================================================
# For equal allocation (n clusters per arm), the formula is:
# n = (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * [lambda_t*VIF_t + lambda_c*VIF_c] / [2*(lambda_c - lambda_t)^2]

z_sum <- z_alpha + z_beta
z_sum_sq <- z_sum^2

variance_sum <- lambda_t * var_inflation_t + lambda_c * var_inflation_c
effect_diff_sq <- (lambda_c - lambda_t)^2

n_uncorrected <- z_sum_sq * variance_sum / (2 * effect_diff_sq)

cat("Formula: n = (z_alpha + z_beta)^2 * [lambda_t*VIF_t + lambda_c*VIF_c] / [2*(lambda_c - lambda_t)^2]\n\n")
cat("z_alpha + z_beta =", z_alpha, "+", z_beta, "=", z_sum, "\n")
cat("(z_alpha + z_beta)^2 =", z_sum_sq, "\n\n")
cat("lambda_t * VIF_t + lambda_c * VIF_c\n")
cat("  =", lambda_t, "*", var_inflation_t, "+", lambda_c, "*", var_inflation_c, "\n")
cat("  =", lambda_t * var_inflation_t, "+", lambda_c * var_inflation_c, "\n")
cat("  =", variance_sum, "\n\n")
cat("(lambda_c - lambda_t)^2 =", effect_diff_sq, "\n")
cat("2 * (lambda_c - lambda_t)^2 =", 2 * effect_diff_sq, "\n\n")
cat("n_uncorrected = ", z_sum_sq, " * ", variance_sum, " / ", 2 * effect_diff_sq, "\n")
cat("              =", n_uncorrected, "clusters per arm\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 4: Apply the one-cluster correction
# ============================================================================
n_corrected <- n_uncorrected + 1

cat("===== STEP 4: One-Cluster Correction =====\n")
cat("n_corrected = n_uncorrected + 1\n")
cat("            =", n_uncorrected, "+ 1\n")
cat("            =", n_corrected, "clusters per arm\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# STEP 5: Round upward to nearest integer
# ============================================================================

var_inflation_c <- 1 + cv_k^2 * (lambda_c - 1)

var_inflation_c <- 1 + cv_k^2 * (lambda_c - 1)
